title: Text
description: Text display UI element for rendering styled text content.
content:
Text

Text display UI element for rendering styled and formatted text content.

Component UI

Schema

JSON
"text": {
  "text": "...",
  "fontSize": 0,
  "color": "...",
  "alignment": "..."
}

Description

The Text component renders text content in the UI with configurable font size, color, and alignment. It is used for labels, titles, descriptions, score displays, and any textual information shown to the player. The text supports dynamic content that can be updated at runtime through commands or data bindings.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
textstringThe text content to display.
fontSizeintThe font size in pixels.
colorstringThe text color (e.g., "#FFFFFF" or "white").
alignmentstringText alignment: "left", "center", or "right".

Example

JSON
{
  "components": {
    "text": {
      "text": "Score: 0",
      "fontSize": 24,
      "color": "#FFFFFF",
      "alignment": "center"
    }
  }
}
